cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Reopen the First Reason
cards.instruction: Keep them present by returning to the first reason for staying and revealing that it now means something different.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You don't hand back your house key standing in the doorway. Come in; I'll make lunch.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've moved out, Mum. The key's on the table.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then lunch can wait. Sit with me while we decide whether that key really has to stay here.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I don't want a key you use to ask why I haven't visited.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep it. No counting visits. I'd rather you used it once because you wanted to.
